title: Fix unawaited async calls and reliability issues in Chat.razor and Pages.razor
description:
## Source
SonarQube static analysis audit (`Data/Pages/audits/ms-sonar-static-analysis-7-26-26.md`)

## Findings
1. **Unawaited async calls (6 instances):** `Chat.razor` call sites for `StartNewChatAsync` and `CancelAsync` without `await` (L688, L702, L1139, L2163, L3099, L3102)
2. **Empty/fill blocks (4 instances):** Empty catch blocks and empty if branches in `Chat.razor` (L1286, L3093, L3113) and `Pages.razor` (L1074)
3. **Unused parameter:** `Maintenance.razor` L353 — `proposalId` parameter never used

## Impact
Unawaited tasks can lead to unobserved exceptions or race conditions. Empty code blocks indicate incomplete error handling or dead code.

## Action Required
1. Add `await` keyword before each `StartNewChatAsync`/`CancelAsync` call in `Chat.razor`. Consider `ConfigureAwait(false)` if appropriate.
2. Either add error handling/logging or remove the empty blocks in `Chat.razor` and `Pages.razor`
3. Remove or implement the unused `proposalId` parameter in `Maintenance.razor`

## Effort
~1h

## Priority
P1 — Reliability
